subject.title: Discord plugin does not auto-reconnect after 1006 WS close (forces full gateway restart, kills in-flight turns)

question: Should maintainers require a fresh live or transport-harness 1005/1006 Discord reproduction on current main before authorizing a repair lane for this issue?
rationale: The issue has strong release-level evidence, but current main has a nominal reconnect implementation plus a later cleanup fix, and the exact failing subpath is not identified from source alone.

options.title: Require current-main recovery proof
options.body: Ask for a focused live Discord or deterministic transport-harness capture that shows whether current main still wedges before opening a repair lane.

options.title: Queue a source-level lifecycle repair
options.body: Allow an automated repair attempt to add a bounded runtime reconnect watchdog despite the missing exact subpath proof.

options.title: Treat PR 101617 as enough
options.body: Close only after maintainers explicitly decide the stale-listener fix plausibly covers this report and provide confirming runtime evidence.

recommendation.title: Require current-main recovery proof
recommendation.body: Ask for a focused live Discord or deterministic transport-harness capture that shows whether current main still wedges before opening a repair lane.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest recent history on Discord gateway supervision and the PR discussion/proof pattern around related reconnect reliability work.
